name: hybridmind
description: Autonomous AI coding agent for VS Code. Plans multi-step tasks, writes code, runs terminal commands with built-in safety validation, and iterates until done. Bring your own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Google, Groq, DeepSeek, or Qwen. Every request goes straight to your provider, billed to your own account.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node test/create-vscode-shim.js

hybridmind.licenseKey.description: HybridMind Pro license key. Get yours at https://hybridmind.dev/pricing

hybridmind.openrouterApiKey.markdownDescription: **Deprecated setting.** Use the `HybridMind: Set API Key (BYOK)` command instead, which stores your key in VS Code's encrypted SecretStorage rather than here in plaintext. If you have never run that command, a key entered here is used once on next activation and then migrated to SecretStorage automatically; after that migration this setting has no effect.

hybridmind.modelSelection.mode.description: Model selection mode: auto (smart selection), manual (user picks), template (predefined chains)

hybridmind.modelSelection.defaultTemplat.description: Default chain template to use in template mode

hybridmind.modelSelection.customChain.description: Custom model chain configuration (role -> model mapping)

hybridmind.ui.showModelBadges.description: Show tier badges on model selectors

hybridmind.userApiProvider.markdownDescription: **Deprecated setting.** Use the `HybridMind: Set API Key (BYOK)` command instead, which stores your provider and key in VS Code's encrypted SecretStorage rather than here in plaintext. Not read after the one-time migration to SecretStorage completes.

hybridmind.userApiKey.markdownDescription: **Deprecated setting.** Use the `HybridMind: Set API Key (BYOK)` command instead, which stores your key in VS Code's encrypted SecretStorage rather than here in plaintext. Not read after the one-time migration to SecretStorage completes.

hybridmind.cloudUrl.description: HybridMind Cloud (optional): Supabase project URL. Leave empty to disable Cloud Pro sign-in/sync entirely -- BYOK works fully without this.

hybridmind.cloudAnonKey.description: HybridMind Cloud (optional): Supabase anon/publishable key. This is meant to be public -- Row Level Security on the server is what actually protects data, not secrecy of this value.

hybridmind.cloudCheckoutUrl.description: HybridMind Cloud (optional): Stripe Checkout link for HybridMind Pro. Leave empty until the Stripe product/price has been created and a checkout link generated.
